lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Al10Ge2 (reduced formula Al5Ge) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmmm (No. 143), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors in two distinct 12-vertex environments, while Ge centers adopt 10-vertex coordination; the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Al 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing between Al and Ge polyhedra.
